# SurfaceGuard 0.1.0

SurfaceGuard 0.1.0 is the first public release.

It provides a versioned JSON policy, a framework-neutral artifact scanner, a Next.js adapter, a command line interface, an ESM library, a bundled GitHub Action, and JSON, Markdown, and SARIF reports.

The scanner covers produced route manifests, client and server JavaScript, static text assets, source maps, sitemap and robots consistency, filename policy, bounded repeated URL decoding, malformed manifests, symlink containment, and resource limits.

The attached package is for direct GitHub installation. This release is not published to npm or another package registry.

Known limitations are documented in `docs/threat-model.md` and `ROADMAP.md`. Version 0.1.0 does not crawl live sites, inspect application source, execute JavaScript, or expand archives and compressed assets.
